Sentence (English): Received our new dishwasher right after a back injury so this unit sat in the garage for a month or so before I could install it - fortunately the install was pretty straight forward and only took me a little over an hour so that was a nice surprise.
Comments (English): [ Time will tell ] || ---------------- || Received our new dishwasher right after a back injury so this unit sat in the garage for a month or so before I could install it - fortunately the install was pretty straight forward and only took me a little over an hour so that was a nice surprise. I like that Bosch sends out both an electrical junction box as well as a pigtail cord that can be plugged into an existing outlet - both of which plug directly into the back of the dishwasher. I guess I'm not sure why they felt they needed to make change from the traditional set-up where you wire the unit directly in but it was nice to have the options. The water line on this unit connects to the very back of the unit with a 3/8" X garden hose adapter. The garden hose adapter seems to be the standard these days but I would prefer the older 3/8" compression connection that you see on most plumbing fixtures. I do NOT like that the water connection is completely out of sight when the unit is installed between the cabinets - makes it very hard to check for any leaks. I did turn the water on prior to sliding the unit in just to check for leaks but I'd feel better about it sitting on my hardwood if I could confirm that AFTER it is permanently in place. No leaks that I can tell but it would be better piece of mind in my opinion. The unit itself seems to be good quality as with most Bosch products - good stainless steel interior - door feel pretty solid. It has a wifi connection available that might be nice for some people - kind of wasted on me though as I really don't see any reason that I'd need to keep up to date with my dishwasher but nice of you want to use it. The layout for the dishes on the bottom rack is a little different than what were used to and does not have any adjustability for the little pegs that hold the dishes in - time will tell if that is a good or bad thing. I don't think this is listed as a fingerprint resistant finish but it does seem to have less finger prints than the old LG unit it replaced.

Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for 2 years now, and we've been very happy with its cleaning capability.
Comments (English): [ Would be near-perfect if not for the awful noise ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for 2 years now, and we've been very happy with its cleaning capability. It's very rare when an item comes out with any residue at all on it. It has great features.However, there is one huge frustration with it. Most of the reviews by other owners state how quiet it is. Well, this certainly isn't the case with our machine. Right from the time it was first installed, it's been so noisy that we've always needed to stuff a big thick slab of styrofoam under the door in front of it, in order to muffle the sound enough to avoid disturbing people in other parts of the house. It makes a very loud, very annoying, whooshing sound, as though the machine is missing some built-in type of sound insulation. It's not the motor that makes the noise, it's the sound of high-pressure water blasting against the metal interior.We called the store about it, but was told that it's normal for it to make a sound. Although the advertised specs for this model mention how quiet it is, we are reasonable enough not to expect silence. Yet we've owned several dishwashers in the past, and never experienced that type of noise with them. In fact, you could barely tell our previous model was running while in the same room with it.I really wish it didn't have this problem because, otherwise, it's a terrific dishwasher. I especially like the extra rack.

There are four modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs! I always use the Standard mode! Standard mode takes about an hour. Fill it with water, select the cycle, and press the start button. It washes everything cleanly, so I can just watch TV and open the door slightly when it's done. It's super convenient, isn't it? I knew the importance and convenience of a dishwasher, but having one in my home... I think I know why they call it "dishwasher aunt~ aunt~". I really recommend this to those who are hesitant to install a dishwasher because of the perforation! It feels like the quality of life has improved? Anyway, it's a whole new world! *Satisfaction: . My life has changed from a life without a dishwasher to a life with one! The non-perforation dishwasher is the best, the best! Highly recommended, highly recommended! It really washes well! Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for 2 years now, and we've been very happy with its cleaning capability.
Comments (English): [ Would be near-perfect if not for the awful noise ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for 2 years now, and we've been very happy with its cleaning capability. It's very rare when an item comes out with any residue at all on it. It has great features. However, there is one huge frustration with it. Most of the reviews by other owners state how quiet it is. Well, this certainly isn't the case with our machine. Right from the time it was first installed, it's been so noisy that we've always needed to stuff a big thick slab of styrofoam under the door in front of it, in order to muffle the sound enough to avoid disturbing people in other parts of the house. It makes a very loud, very annoying, whooshing sound, as though the machine is missing some built-in type of sound insulation. It's not the motor that makes the noise, it's the sound of high-pressure water blasting against the metal interior. We called the store about it, but was told that it's normal for it to make a sound. Although the advertised specs for this model mention how quiet it is, we are reasonable enough not to expect silence. Yet we've owned several dishwashers in the past, and never experienced that type of noise with them. In fact, you could barely tell our previous model was running while in the same room with it. I really wish it didn't have this problem because, otherwise, it's a terrific dishwasher. I especially like the extra rack.

Sentence (English): Bought as a replacement for our original GE that failed horribly with leaks after 6 years.
Comments (English): [ Performs great with one caveat ] || ---------------- || Bought as a replacement for our original GE that failed horribly with leaks after 6 years. The unit looks good and although not a highly featured model does everything we need. Ultra quiet and it does a great job cleaning anything we've put in. We use a pouch that includes a rinse so we don't use the extra rinse agents. The only issue is the complete drying since the unit doesn't have a drying element like most dishwashers. We've enabled the extra drying mode (programmable) and select the extra dry button. It uses super heated water interacting with the rinse products to dry its contents. Dishes and silverware are in general completely dry. Items that can't all the water to completely run off have some water on them. Not sure if extra rinse product would help. I was aware of this based on previous reviews so it's acceptable to me. Quiet operation and great cleaning were what I wanted.

And there's no heated dry option, which is strange to deal with.

Sentence (English): Over the decades, I've used a number of dishwashers made by a number of manufacturers.
Comments (English): [ my dream machine ] || ---------------- || Over the decades, I've used a number of dishwashers made by a number of manufacturers. When our last one gave up the ghost just prior to a big Thanksgiving dinner, I knew I had to get a replacement quickly. Reviews pointed to this Bosch model being in my price range and amazingly, I found a single unit (! ) available in my region at the time. I was out the door within half an hour and at the store to buy it. I've never regretted it. I love the top rack for flatware, cooking utensils, and small items. I love the that the middle rack can be adjusted vertically to accommodate larger items on it, or on the bottom rack. I love that there are various adjustable tines on each of the middle and bottom racks. It's fantastic that you can put large plastic containers on the bottom rack and not have to worry about them melting! I can pack this machine full with every sort of dish, bowl, and container and everything comes out spotless. I do *not* put in pots and pans, but that's just me. You certainly could. When I'm making a feast over a few days and doing a lot of baking, this dishwasher is in almost constant use with cleaning all the prep dishes. My 6 qt mixer's bowl fits on the bottom rack just fine! And did I mention how quiet this is? If not for the little red light shining onto the floor, you wouldn't even know it was running.

Sentence (English): I'm guessing all the positive reviews are incentivized in some way, because this dishwasher is so disappointing, compared to our 12-year old cheap one that was just getting too loud.
Comments (English): [ Poorly designed, dishes smell, regret purchase ] || ---------------- || I'm guessing all the positive reviews are incentivized in some way, because this dishwasher is so disappointing, compared to our 12-year old cheap one that was just getting too loud. The racks are oddly positioned and it is much harder to fit dishes in than our old one, there's less flexibility in where you can put things so you can't get as many dishes cleaned. It's like they didn't test it with common dish sizes. The door has no latch which means you're wrenching it free of its catch every time which feels wrong. Top rack feels loose and bottom rack, which holds all the weight, doesn't glide as easily as our 12-year-old dishwasher did. It does get the dishes clean, but after only a couple of months it's making our dishes smell like wet dog. Apparently water doesn't entirely drain out of the pump unless it's installed a certain way (we had professional installation and installed to code) which then sits in the filter (even when filter is clean) and stagnates. It's gross and affects meals, drinks, etc. As others have mentioned, even using rinse aid and highest settings, plastic dishes don't dry and when you pull out the loose top rack it spills that water all over the lower dishes so everything is wet. It is quiet, but overall our cheap old dishwasher was better and we want to return this, but don't exactly want to spend the money for another installation…

Sentence (English): My #1 priority was a quiet dishwasher and research told me this was one of the quietest on the market - and dang is it quiet!
Comments (English): My #1 priority was a quiet dishwasher and research told me this was one of the quietest on the market - and dang is it quiet! Our previous dishwasher we only washed over night at bed it was so loud - this one as indicated often you can barely hear it is running. We will run it now even in our open floor plan where the TV couch is right behind the island counter with the dishwasher. The only "loud" part of dishwashing now seems unavoidable - when the dishwasher pumps out dirty water into the sink drain the rush of water is a bit loud - but I suppose that is unavoidable as the sound is actually coming from the sink drain hole. It only lasts a few seconds and happens 2-3 times a cycle so no big deal. The installation was easy enough, I did it myself. The hardest part was clamping it to the sink counter but a few youtube videos got me through it. It's also slightly dififcult to adjust the feet just right to have it level if you have no tile where the back feet are - but it was manageable. At first the 3rd rack feels weird to put silverware on top - but I took out the silverware racks (they sit in the under sink cabinet unused now) and the main benefit is you have more space on the bottom rack if you don't use the silverware holder. Also while putting the silverware in the dishwasher takes more time - taking out is actually faster because you just grab handfuls of silverware and easily put them back in a drawer. I mostly use it on auto (and I am using rinse aid) - the cleaning and drying is excellent. I used heavy 1 time on some super soiled pots & pans and they came out spotless - so that is nice. Haven't used the quick cycles yet but I read that the quick cycles + sanitize are great for quick runs with baby bottles and I'll be dealing with that in a few months.

Sentence (English): This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Sentence (English): I used to use a dishwasher from another brand.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): One of my three aunts is a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

 하지만 식세기의 장점은  손설거지보다 적은 양의 물로, 더 확실하게  더 뽀득하게 설거지 해준다는 점이에요. 특히 기름 잔뜩 묻은 접시들에서 그 강점이  유감없이 발휘된답니다. 전, 후 사진보시면 제육볶음 해먹고 시뻘건 고추기름이 묻었던 접시들이 깨끗해졌어요. 싱크대에 막 쌓아두고 무려 12시간 지나서 설거지한터라 그릇 뒷편까지 기름이 덕지덕지 뭍고 다 말라비틀어진 극한 설거지였는데도 미디어 식세기로 깔끔~ 수저들도 새로 산 수저들처럼 반짝반짝~ 만져봐도 뽀득뽀득합니다. ㅎㅎ 전후 사진 중 컵사진은 차 마신 후 3일간 그냥 놔둬서 말라비틀어진 컵이에요.ㅋㅋㅋ 불림 없이 바로 식기세척기에 넣었는데도 말끔해졌어요. ㅎㅎㅎ 4. 완전 넒은 상하단 트레이 2단으로 된 상단, 하단 트레이에 접시, 밥그릇, 국그릇은  물론이고 각종 냄비와 후라이팬까지 적재 가능해요. 수저통도 완전 넉넉해서 식구 많은 집도 오케이.  저희 집은 식구는 많지 않지만 수저 설거지가 왜 이리 많이 나오는지…. 40개 넘는 수저가 한 큐에 세척 가능합니다. ㅎㅎㅎ  특히 상단 트레이는 간단하게 높이 조절이 가능해서  아래에 큰 팬이나 냄비 넣을 때 아주 편합니다.  사진에 보이시는 팬은 30cm짜리 대형 후라이팬이에요. 대형 후라이팬,  심지어 기름에 쩌든 후라이팬 뚜껑까지 싹 다 넣어도 널널합니다.^^ 그동안 뚜껑 설거지라도 줄이려고  종이 호일 쓰고,  골판지 덮고.....  별 짓 다 했는데 이제 부담없이 뚜껑에 기름이 튀거나~ 말거나~ 미디어 식세기가 있으니 마음이 편해집니다. ㅎㅎㅎ  5. 다양한 방법의 7 가지 세척코스 전 솔직히 이거 처음 봐서 신기했어요. 와인잔이나 크리스털 제품 같은 연약한 제품 종류를 세척할 수 있는 코스가 있더라구요.  이제 와인잔, 크리스탈 제품도 안심하고 돌릴수 있어요.  강력, 표준, 에코, 유리, 90분, 쾌속, 애벌 불림 코스까지. 다양한 방법의 7가지 코스로 안성맞춤. 애벌 기능으로 말라비틀어진 밥풀들도 걱정없겠어요. 근데 전 말라비틀어진 밥풀들도 표준 코스로 돌려도 잘 세척되더라구요. ㅋㅋㅋ  6.  편리한 설치 기사님이 바로 다음 날 연락와서  빌트인으로 금방 설치해주셨습니다. 친절하게 설명도 다 해주셨구요. 저희는 빌트인으로 설치했는데 색상도 세련된 은회색에  디자인도 어찌나 멋진지…!! No~! 식세기 살까 말까 하는 분들,  전기세, 물세 많이 나올까봐 걱정되시나요? 실제로는 손설거지 보다 물은 1/3 정도만 쓰여서  물 절약에도 좋습니다. 손설거지 물사용량 평균 50리터, 식세기 물사용량 14리터라고 해요.  전기세는 하루 1회 사용 기준 시 (450와트. 2시간시 900와트) 네이*에서 전기세 계산시 매일 써도 한 달에 천원 정도  더 나오네요.  한달에 천원 쓰고  설거지 스트레스에서 벗어나세요~ 참고로 모든 설거지는 애벌설거지 안 한 상태로 넣었습니다. 애벌 설거지 해야할 정도면 뭐하러 식세기 쓰나요? 그냥 넣어도 이렇게 세척력이 좋은걸요?! 전 귀찮아서 그냥 음식물 찌꺼기만 대충 털어내고 넣었어요. 그리고 테스트는 표준모드와 에코모드로 세척했습니다. 아마 강력모드나 불림모드를 쓴다면 더 강력하겠죠? ㅋㅋㅋ 그런데 에코모드로도 이렇게 말끔~ 뽀득~ 해지니  품질 진심 인정합니다.  눈을 부릅뜨고 단점을 찾으려 했으나 딱히 단점을 찾을 수 없는 좋은 제품입니다.ㅎㅎ  식세기가 생기니 장점 중 하나는 밥먹을때 설거지가 두렵지않아서 온갖 반찬들 각각 그릇에 다 담고 각자 앞접시를 다 꺼내 쓸 수 있답니다. ㅋ 3-4인용 일반 가정집을 물론이거니와 집들이나 모임 등 대규모 설거지도 충분히 가능하다 생각됩니다. 식세기로 편안한 식사시간, 휴식시간이 찾아옵니다. 미디어 식기세척기, 실속있는 선택으로 추천해요~!!  솔직한 후기 입니다. 아래 \'도움이 됐어요.\' 눌러주시면 감사합니다!!! 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Sentence (English): That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~!
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
