Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
