Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

 하지만 식세기의 장점은  손설거지보다 적은 양의 물로, 더 확실하게  더 뽀득하게 설거지 해준다는 점이에요. 특히 기름 잔뜩 묻은 접시들에서 그 강점이  유감없이 발휘된답니다. 전, 후 사진보시면 제육볶음 해먹고 시뻘건 고추기름이 묻었던 접시들이 깨끗해졌어요. 싱크대에 막 쌓아두고 무려 12시간 지나서 설거지한터라 그릇 뒷편까지 기름이 덕지덕지 뭍고 다 말라비틀어진 극한 설거지였는데도 미디어 식세기로 깔끔~ 수저들도 새로 산 수저들처럼 반짝반짝~ 만져봐도 뽀득뽀득합니다. ㅎㅎ 전후 사진 중 컵사진은 차 마신 후 3일간 그냥 놔둬서 말라비틀어진 컵이에요.ㅋㅋㅋ 불림 없이 바로 식기세척기에 넣었는데도 말끔해졌어요. ㅎㅎㅎ 4. 완전 넒은 상하단 트레이 2단으로 된 상단, 하단 트레이에 접시, 밥그릇, 국그릇은  물론이고 각종 냄비와 후라이팬까지 적재 가능해요. 수저통도 완전 넉넉해서 식구 많은 집도 오케이.  저희 집은 식구는 많지 않지만 수저 설거지가 왜 이리 많이 나오는지…. 40개 넘는 수저가 한 큐에 세척 가능합니다. ㅎㅎㅎ  특히 상단 트레이는 간단하게 높이 조절이 가능해서  아래에 큰 팬이나 냄비 넣을 때 아주 편합니다.  사진에 보이시는 팬은 30cm짜리 대형 후라이팬이에요. 대형 후라이팬,  심지어 기름에 쩌든 후라이팬 뚜껑까지 싹 다 넣어도 널널합니다.^^ 그동안 뚜껑 설거지라도 줄이려고  종이 호일 쓰고,  골판지 덮고.....  별 짓 다 했는데 이제 부담없이 뚜껑에 기름이 튀거나~ 말거나~ 미디어 식세기가 있으니 마음이 편해집니다. ㅎㅎㅎ  5. 다양한 방법의 7 가지 세척코스 전 솔직히 이거 처음 봐서 신기했어요. 와인잔이나 크리스털 제품 같은 연약한 제품 종류를 세척할 수 있는 코스가 있더라구요.  이제 와인잔, 크리스탈 제품도 안심하고 돌릴수 있어요.  강력, 표준, 에코, 유리, 90분, 쾌속, 애벌 불림 코스까지. 다양한 방법의 7가지 코스로 안성맞춤. 애벌 기능으로 말라비틀어진 밥풀들도 걱정없겠어요. 근데 전 말라비틀어진 밥풀들도 표준 코스로 돌려도 잘 세척되더라구요. ㅋㅋㅋ  6.  편리한 설치 기사님이 바로 다음 날 연락와서  빌트인으로 금방 설치해주셨습니다. 친절하게 설명도 다 해주셨구요. 저희는 빌트인으로 설치했는데 색상도 세련된 은회색에  디자인도 어찌나 멋진지…!! Sentence (English): Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher?
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
