Sentence (English): A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Sentence (English): I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~!
Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Automatic door opening, clean cleaning, practical media dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Media 12-person dishwasher. I used to use a dishwasher from another brand. When I moved, I left it behind and the empty space was so big. One of my three aunts is a dishwasher. Even if I only wash dishes, my body feels better. That's why I chose the Media 12-person dishwasher! The brand Media is less well-known in Korea, but I heard that domestic major brands that are famous for their dishwashers actually bring in Media products and sell them in an OEM manner. (News) However, the price is 2-3 times that of Media. Choosing Media with a practical approach is a wise choice~! ^-^b Features and advantages 1. All-stainless steel interior As someone who has already used a dishwasher, this is important. If the interior is partially made of plastic, only that part gets wet and gets dirty quickly. And even if it uses safe materials, I feel uncomfortable with plastic for products that use hot water. Of course, stainless steel wins in terms of durability. 2. Automatic door opening function Whether or not the door opens is really important. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry quickly even if you just open the door. I often leave the door open and let it dry rather than using the separate drying function, and it dries really quickly because it's hot. So I feel comfortable even if I make a reservation and go to bed. If there is no door-opening function, the smell of water is overwhelming. The door-opening function is really essential. 3. 360-degree powerful water jet cleaning power A powerful water stream that rotates 360 degrees washes all kinds of food scraps and such. I took detailed pictures to test the actual cleaning power. ^^ As you can see in the pictures, there is dried rice paste, pork fat, kimchi soup, and even sauce seasoning that doesn't come off. I tested various things. In fact, these are the types that don't come off even with hand washing, so I have to wash them 2-3 times with a lot of detergent and hot water. ; Washing them is hard. Especially pork/beef fat. It doesn't come off. bb If I grill meat once, I'm stressed out about washing the dishes that day! However, the advantage of the dishwasher is that it washes dishes more thoroughly and more thoroughly with less water than hand washing. This advantage is especially evident on dishes that are covered in oil. If you look at the before and after pictures, the plates that were covered in red chili oil from stir-fried pork are now clean. I had just piled them up in the sink and washed them after 12 hours, so the backs of the dishes were all covered in oil and dried and warped. It was an extreme dishwashing, but it was clean with the media dishwasher~ The spoons are also shiny like new spoons~ They are smooth to the touch. Among the before and after pictures, the cup pictured is a cup that was dried and warped after being left out for 3 days after drinking tea. It was clean even though I put it in the dishwasher right away without soaking it. 4. Very wide upper and lower trays The two-tiered upper and lower trays can hold plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and even various pots and frying pans. The cutlery holder is also very spacious, so it's okay for a family with many people. My family doesn't have many people, but why do we have so many cutlery dishes? More than 40 cutlery can be washed at once. In particular, the upper tray can be easily adjusted in height, so it's very convenient to put a large pan or pot underneath. The pan you see in the picture is a 30cm large frying pan. Even if you put in a large frying pan, including a frying pan lid soaked in oil, it's still spacious. ^^ In the past, I tried to reduce the amount of lid dishes by using paper foil, covering it with cardboard, and doing everything, but now I can feel at ease without worrying about oil splashing on the lid or not~ I have a media dishwasher. 5. 7 washing courses with various methods Honestly, I was surprised because I saw this for the first time. There's a course for washing delicate products such as wine glasses or crystal products. Now I can safely use wine glasses and crystal products. From strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, quick, and larval soaking courses. It's perfect with 7 different courses. You don't have to worry about dried rice balls with the larvae function. But I washed the dried rice balls well even with the standard course. 6. The convenient installation technician contacted me the next day and quickly installed it as a built-in. He kindly explained everything to me. We installed it as a built-in, and the color is a sophisticated silver gray and the design is so cool! It's 60cm wide and 82cm long, so it seems like it can be built into most sinks. Of course, it's also possible to use it as a freestanding one. It's great because you can use it as a built-in or freestanding one depending on your home situation. 7. Worried about electricity and water bills? No~! Are you worried about whether or not to buy a dishwasher? In reality, only about 1/3 of the water is used compared to hand washing, so it's good for saving water. They say that the average water usage for hand washing is 50 liters, and the water usage for a dishwasher is 14 liters. When calculating the electricity bill at Naver* based on daily usage (450 watts, 900 watts for 2 hours), it comes out to about 1,000 won more per month even if you use it every day. Spend 1,000 won a month and get rid of the stress of washing dishes~ For reference, all the dishes were put in without pre-washing. If you have to pre-wash the dishes, why use a dishwasher? Is the cleaning power this good even if you just put it in? I was lazy, so I just roughly shook off the food scraps and put it in. And I washed it in the standard mode and eco mode for the test. It would probably be more powerful if you use the strong mode or the soaking mode. However, even in the eco mode, it is so clean and crisp that I truly acknowledge the quality. I tried to find shortcomings with my eyes wide open, but I couldn't find any shortcomings. One of the advantages of having a dishwasher is that you don't have to worry about washing dishes when you eat, so you can put all the side dishes in their own bowls and take out each person's plate. I think it's enough for a regular home for 3-4 people, as well as large-scale dishwashing for housewarming parties or gatherings. A comfortable mealtime and rest time come with a dishwasher. I recommend the Media Dishwasher as a practical choice~! This is an honest review. Please click the "This was helpful" button below to thank me! ㅋㅋ 가로 60 센티, 세로82센티로 웬간한 싱크대에는 다 빌트인 가능할 것 같습니다. 물론 프리스탠딩도 가능하다고 해요.  각자 집 사정에 따라 빌트인, 프리스탠딩 다 가능하니 참 좋네요.  7. 전기세, 물세 걱정? No~! 식세기 살까 말까 하는 분들,  전기세, 물세 많이 나올까봐 걱정되시나요? 실제로는 손설거지 보다 물은 1/3 정도만 쓰여서  물 절약에도 좋습니다. 손설거지 물사용량 평균 50리터, 식세기 물사용량 14리터라고 해요.  전기세는 하루 1회 사용 기준 시 (450와트. 2시간시 900와트) 네이*에서 전기세 계산시 매일 써도 한 달에 천원 정도  더 나오네요.  한달에 천원 쓰고  설거지 스트레스에서 벗어나세요~ 참고로 모든 설거지는 애벌설거지 안 한 상태로 넣었습니다. 애벌 설거지 해야할 정도면 뭐하러 식세기 쓰나요? 그냥 넣어도 이렇게 세척력이 좋은걸요?! 전 귀찮아서 그냥 음식물 찌꺼기만 대충 털어내고 넣었어요. 그리고 테스트는 표준모드와 에코모드로 세척했습니다. 아마 강력모드나 불림모드를 쓴다면 더 강력하겠죠? ㅋㅋㅋ 그런데 에코모드로도 이렇게 말끔~ 뽀득~ 해지니  품질 진심 인정합니다.  눈을 부릅뜨고 단점을 찾으려 했으나 딱히 단점을 찾을 수 없는 좋은 제품입니다.ㅎㅎ  식세기가 생기니 장점 중 하나는 밥먹을때 설거지가 두렵지않아서 온갖 반찬들 각각 그릇에 다 담고 각자 앞접시를 다 꺼내 쓸 수 있답니다. ㅋ 3-4인용 일반 가정집을 물론이거니와 집들이나 모임 등 대규모 설거지도 충분히 가능하다 생각됩니다. 식세기로 편안한 식사시간, 휴식시간이 찾아옵니다. 미디어 식기세척기, 실속있는 선택으로 추천해요~!!  솔직한 후기 입니다. 아래 \'도움이 됐어요.\' 눌러주시면 감사합니다!!! 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

After washing, I took everything out, wiped it dry with a cloth, and opened it again. I used the well-known Frog detergent. For 3-person and a half, for 12-person or more, one, and for less than that, a half. I saw other people fill buckets with water and have them dispense with it. I thought I'd do that too, but he connected the water. That's great. Just fill the bucket, put it away, and voila. You'll probably have to order the griddle separately. I've included a photo of the griddle I'm using. However, when I close the lid, the gap on the right side of the door is narrower than the left. Is this normal? I've only used it for a few days. I always put in one bottle of frog detergent, but it smells. So even with half a bottle, it still smells. What could be the problem? I thought it was strange, so I rinsed it for another 30 minutes. And it didn't work. Do I need to wash it more? Hmm. I guess there was some kind of error. 10.1. It's strange. I don't put in containers with eggs or fish, but there's a strange fishy smell. I rinse it twice, but it still smells, and I always open the filter after use. But why does it smell? I bought dishwasher detergent, but it still smells. I've tried reducing and increasing the amount of detergent, and even switching to liquid detergent. How do I get rid of it? It says not to put plastic items in it, so I intentionally left plastic cups and bowls out, but the frog detergent and fishy smell mix together. I can still smell it in the washed cups, so I rinse them again by hand. If anyone knows how to fix this, please add it to my review. 11.19. Idiot. I bought a different color of frog detergent again. Sentence (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying.
Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Sentence (English): Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals.
Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Sentence (English): With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating!
Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Sentence (English): Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies!
Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Sentence (English): I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?"
Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Sentence (English): I chose it because it was the perfect size!
Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it!
