Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Sentence (English): Instructions for using the cycle.
Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Sentence (English): It's amazing!
Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Comments (English): I'm a meticulous shopper who researches and reviews before buying. I received this dishwasher from Coupang, so I wrote a thorough review. Final Thoughts: We're a two-person household, and we love to cook and enjoy home-cooked meals. Even one meal can leave us with a lot of dishes to wash. With this dishwasher doing such a great job, I don't have to worry about washing dishes while eating! That's why I love it so much. Washing dishes frees me up for other hobbies! Reasons for Choosing: This is one of my three aunts' dishwashers. I'd never used one before, so I was worried it might be unusable or inconvenient. But the fact that this 3-person dishwasher doesn't require installation or drilling gave me the courage to try it. I heard it's so convenient, so I thought, "Should I give it a try?" The media dishwasher had good reviews, so I gave it a try. Design: I prefer white appliances, but the black option is white and black, so it didn't look too overwhelming. The touchscreen was easy to use, too. Size: It's a little bigger than the oven-type air fryer I have at home. I measured it to see if it would fit in my kitchen, and the width was plenty roomy, and the height was just right for the small TV panel in my kitchen. I chose it because it was the perfect size! It'll be helpful if you carefully consider the width, length, and height before making a purchase. The important thing is how to add water. Since it's not installed, you have to add water separately. 1. Turn on the power first so that it recognizes the water level! 2. Pour 5L of water using the included water cup. 3. Since it's a 1.8L cup, pour in 1.8L + 1.8L + 1.4L. It beeped when it was full. Then stop adding water! If you pour water without first turning it on, it won't recognize the water, which could damage the product. Be sure to follow this order! Five stars. Instructions for using the cycle. Wash the pre-washed water, put it in the dishwasher, and select the cleaning cycle. Standard: 64 minutes, wash 65, rinse 70, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Powerful: 81 minutes, wash 65, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.5kWh, water consumption 5L. Eco: 80 minutes, wash 50, rinse 65, dry, power consumption 0.3kWh, water consumption 5L. Rapid: 29 minutes, wash 55, rinse 60, dry, power consumption 0.27kWh, water consumption 5L. Steam sterilization: 64 minutes, wash 50, rinse 72, dry, power consumption 0.4kWh, water consumption 5L. Since the water consumption is all 5L, you can choose the course according to the purpose. I used standard or rapid. It seems that people who use bottles use steam sterilization. After using it, the cleaning power is really good. I used to wash and clean by hand, but I wondered how well a machine could do it. It's amazing! It has a drying program after the wash is done, even if you don't leave the door open. The fan runs for 72 hours, so it's better than a dishwasher that just turns off! However, after using it, I wish there was a separate drying-only cycle. It doesn't dry well, so I hate leaving even a single drop of moisture behind. It's a bit disappointing. And it makes some noise when the water is added and drained. I was a bit surprised at first. So I don't recommend using the dishwasher too early or late in the morning! However, after using it, it was so good that it was worth installing and using without any hesitation. I think it's much better than buying expensive, brand-name products. I recommend it! Buy a dishwasher for sure, but don't get this one its awful.

Sentence (English): We've been using our dishwasher for about a month and love it.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher but installation nightmare ] || ---------------- || We've been using our dishwasher for about a month and love it. Read further for the installation nightmare. The layout of the racks is very well thought out and can fit a lot of dishes. I love the extra shelf on top for knives, big utensils and shallow bowls. A word of caution- we placed a plastic dog bowl holder on the top rack and during the cycle it was knocked off and landed on the bottom heating element. It melted and wrapped around the element causing a horrible odor. We had to use a hair dryer and soldering iron to soften the plastic to remove it. Don't place light weight objects on the top rack. The dishwasher cleans very well and dries everything the best of any we have had. Controls are easy to see and front panel doesn't show drips or fingerprints. Overall a great dishwasher. Installation was a problem. Costco uses 2 separate contractors- one to deliver and a different one to install and haul away the old unit. Delivery was perfect and on schedule. We were told we would receive a call in a few hours to set up installation, probably later that day. Instead we got a call saying they couldn't do the installation until 5 days later. Then a call again rescheduling, and then again and again. They would always cancel on the day they were scheduled to be here. Meanwhile we had already disconnected the old dishwasher and it was sitting on our patio while the new dishwasher was sitting in a box in the middle of our kitchen. It took 3 weeks and a lot of time on the phone to finally get them out. We would have installed it ourselves but were told by Costco it would void the warranty. The actual installer was great- professional and knowledgeable. But his company was horrible- very poor customer service and we didn't get a lot of help from Costco's concierge service.

We contacted KitchenAid and they sent us to a local Service Company to come and look at it. A week and a half later the Service Man arrived and determined the motor was bad. Thankfully he had a replacement part in his van. We are frustrated that a brand new dishwasher arrived with a major component problem. Replace the part, still doesn't work. 5. Decide to replace appliance. 6. Order new appliance. 7. Wait for the new appliance. 8. Install the new appliance. 9. It doesn't work 10. Wait for Service 11. Replace a major component on a brand-new dishwasher 12. Any chance of feeling good about it is gone.

Comments (English): [ Love it except for the silverware basket ] || ---------------- || It's an attractive and relatively quiet dishwasher, and super good value for the money. We've had Bosch dishwashers before and expect the same high-quality performance from this one. The only thing I don't like is that there's no practical place to put the silverware basket. It's square and designed to sit on the right or left side, in the center section of bottom rack. That that means half the dish slots in the bottom rack are blocked by the silverware basket. That one thing was not well thought out and it's annoying. If it could sit in the front or back of the bottom rack there would be a lot more space for dishes, but it will only fit in the center area.We installed the dishwasher ourselves and it was relatively easy with two people. As far as the purchase process, it was easy. We bought the dishwasher online from Lowes. The next day we went to Lowes and it was waiting for us by the door. My husband and the Lowes guy lifted it into the back of our SUV with no problem. It easily fit in the back of the SUV. It's not that heavy so my husband was able to remove it from the vehicle and bring it in the house himself.

Sentence (English): I agonized for nearly six months over whether or not to buy a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It's a waste of time to hesitate. Buy it right away. ] || ---------------- || I agonized for nearly six months over whether or not to buy a dishwasher. Built-in or freestanding. Samsung or LG; other brands excluded. It was either my wife not buying it or me buying it. After much negotiation with my wife, we agreed to purchase a freestanding model. A Samsung technician came and finished the installation quickly. The water supply was installed at the water inlet point under the sink. Before installation, the Samsung technician contacted me to inform me that a water inlet hole needed to be drilled. You need to have the drilling point in mind beforehand. In our house, there is a separate area under the sink for dish soap, so we installed it there without drilling a separate hole. The drain line is quite long, but I didn't cut it and just installed it as is. The technician said he wouldn't cut it. Even though it is long, it is usually rolled up and secured. I had intended to make it straight because I was worried that if I rolled it up, the water wouldn't drain completely and the water might rot. But since he told me not to cut it, I let it slide. I used it for the first time, and the dishes are nice and warm, and they seem to be cleaned well. At first, I thought they might be completely dry, but there are still droplets forming. Still, I am satisfied with this. I don't think I can fit large frying pans in it. I was hesitating to get a built-in model because of this. If you are planning to buy one, I recommend visiting a store to take a look before making your choice. I think it is very good; I recommend it. -----------------Additional Review-------------------. Washing dishes in a dishwasher usually takes about an hour. My wife used to complain, saying, "If it's going to take that long, I'd just do it myself," but after running it exactly three times, she immediately changed her mind. She said, "It seems pretty good." I hope this was helpful in some way. This was my honest personal review.

Samsung or LG; other brands excluded. It was either my wife not buying it or me buying it. After much negotiation with my wife, we agreed to purchase a freestanding model. A Samsung technician came and finished the installation quickly. The water supply was installed at the water inlet point under the sink. Before installation, the Samsung technician contacted me to inform me that a water inlet hole needed to be drilled. You need to have the drilling point in mind beforehand. In our house, there is a separate area under the sink for dish soap, so we installed it there without drilling a separate hole. The drain line is quite long, but I didn't cut it and just installed it as is. The technician said he wouldn't cut it. Even though it is long, it is usually rolled up and secured. I had intended to make it straight because I was worried that if I rolled it up, the water wouldn't drain completely and the water might rot. But since he told me not to cut it, I let it slide. I used it for the first time, and the dishes are nice and warm, and they seem to be cleaned well. At first, I thought they might be completely dry, but there are still droplets forming. Still, I am satisfied with this. I don't think I can fit large frying pans in it. I was hesitating to get a built-in model because of this. If you are planning to buy one, I recommend visiting a store to take a look before making your choice. I think it is very good; I recommend it. -----------------Additional Review-------------------. Washing dishes in a dishwasher usually takes about an hour. My wife used to complain, saying, "If it's going to take that long, I'd just do it myself," but after running it exactly three times, she immediately changed her mind. She said, "It seems pretty good." I hope this was helpful in some way. This was my honest personal review.

The SK Magic machine you exchanged ] || ---------------- || When I first received the dishwasher, the door opened wide by about 15cm, so I had to exchange it. However, after replacing and installing again, I opened the door and the door opened by almost 20cm. The SK Magic technician who replaced it told me to just use it because the door opening a lot doesn't mean there is a problem with the product's performance. I decided to just use it, but the more I use it, the more inconvenient it becomes. It's really inconvenient. I wash dishes like pots and pans next to the sink. It's a space where water drains, so you always have to be careful that it doesn't collide with the dishwasher door. And as time goes by, the door is opening more and more. I searched a lot on Naver View and YouTube and found that it is normal for the dishwasher door to open about 3 to 5 cm. Just in case, I asked the seller here, and he said that the opening is 3 to 5 cm. If you have limited sink space like me, make sure to check how far the door opens before installing, even if it is inconvenient. For reference, I purchased it during a live broadcast in early July 23. The actual purchase price is 490,000 won with benefits such as credit card discounts and Naver Pay points earned when you write a review after purchase? I think it was around 500,000 won. I also received Frosh detergent (30 units) as a free gift. Although there are some disappointments in terms of hardware, I still think it is better value for money than other companies. I like the two-tiered one the most. When I see the water pressure of the dishwasher being explained during a live broadcast. I thought the water pressure would be very strong. Even when I put a really light plastic plate in the dishwasher and turned it around, the plate didn't move and stayed in place, so I guess the water pressure wasn't that strong.

Sentence (English): 10/10 for delivery speed, old machine removal and installation.
Comments (English): [ Installation was great, product not so much ] || ---------------- || 10/10 for delivery speed, old machine removal and installation. We received the machine within a few days of ordering and the installers were quick and courteous (make sure you empty out your cabinet under the sink prior to their arrival- it will help things go quickly). Removal of old machine and installation of new machine took place on the same day despite the order saying a second day for installation was necessary My issues with this machine: - plastic inside (not fully steel as pictured- just the door is steel) so it's not drying on “heated dry” mode -noise - somewhat noisy because of the plastic but certainly not that bad -the top rack barely fits the number of mugs and glasses we use in a household of two adults and literally barely fits the size of standard mugs. Basically if your mug is round or with a wider lip it won't fit without using two rows. - very little tilt to the cup rack so water will always pool on the cups - there is only one cutlery basket which is not terrible but options for washing smaller items like baby bottle tops etc are very limited -no way of moving any of the prongs on the lower rack to accommodate larger items like bakeware, bowls or pots- it's really only meant for plates - this machine is probably meant for a small apartment with folks who don't cook a lot and run the wash every night

I am VERY VERY happy with this purchase.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is connected to WiFi so she needed a name to identify her when we get messages, so Brenda Bosch is her name.
Comments (English): [ Brenda is a wonderful dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is connected to WiFi so she needed a name to identify her when we get messages, so Brenda Bosch is her name.Going from a simple push button dishwasher to this electronic model takes a bit of getting use to. There are many video's provided by Bosch on all the many features of the dishwasher. Watch the video's and you will have no issues.Plusses:- Brenda cleans the toughest of stains and leaves the dishes spotless.- Very quiet operation, without the LED on the front of Brenda you would hardly hear her running.- Love the top drawer for knives and forks, no utensils stuck together, each comes out spotless.- The stainless front and interior are really stainless, no finger prints.Minor changes I would like to see:- Lowest rack could use another wire bar on each side as some bowls can get thru the sides and hit when closing the door.- Would like a two color LED on the front door. One color to say Brenda is running(which is what is there now) and the color change when Brenda is finished. The second color would go OFF once the door has been opened after completing the cleaning cycles. - Would like a different mounting method to the side cabinets other than having to screw directly into the side of the finish cabinetry. Previous dishwasher mounted to a block on the back of the cabinet face.

Comments (English): [ oh my god ] || ---------------- || Installation was completed in one day. First, they took out all the stuff in the lower cabinet, then painstakingly removed the cabinets, and for an additional 30,000 won, they secured the top plate to the cabinet so that it wouldn't fall off. I love it~ I was using a small dishwasher, but when I changed to a 12-person one, what a new world it was~~~. I debated 100 times whether to buy a 14-person one, but since it was only 400,000 won more, I just picked the 12-person one with rocket delivery. I made a great choice. I wanted white because the cabinet color was white, but I didn't have it, so I went with beige. It's not bad, and the color is luxurious. Ex) Dryer from 9K to the largest size, dining table from 4-person to 6-person, sofa from 4-person to 6-person, bed from queen size to K, etc. When you are like me, don't regret buying a small capacity to save a little money and buy a large one unconditionally. First, they took out all the stuff in the lower cabinet, then painstakingly removed the cabinets, and for an additional 30,000 won, they secured the top plate to the cabinet so that it wouldn't fall off. I don't think the installation took even 30 minutes. After that, I put in things that I didn't need to wash. Even with all the frying pans and pots, there was still plenty of space. I love it~ I was using a small dishwasher, but when I changed to a 12-person one, what a new world it was~~~. I debated 100 times whether to buy a 14-person one, but since it was only 400,000 won more, I just picked the 12-person one with rocket delivery. I made a great choice. I wanted white because the cabinet color was white, but I didn't have it, so I went with beige. It's not bad, and the color is luxurious. If you're thinking about it, I don't think you'll regret choosing this one. I always said I'd waste money, so I chose a smaller one, but after a few years, I kept changing it, and the cost doubled. Ex) Dryer from 9K to the largest size, dining table from 4-person to 6-person, sofa from 4-person to 6-person, bed from queen size to K, etc. When you are like me, don't regret buying a small capacity to save a little money and buy a large one unconditionally. There doesn't seem to be much difference between a 14-person and a 12-person dishwasher, as long as you don't live with more than 10 people. This is the best! Highly recommended. The technician was also kind and I am grateful^^

Sentence (English): We bought this LG dishwasher to replace one that had lasted for 17 years.
Comments (English): [ Sound level is fabulous ] || ---------------- || We bought this LG dishwasher to replace one that had lasted for 17 years. We wanted white to match everything else in our kitchen and LG was one of the few companies that offered while without charging extra for that. A selling point was the decibel level. We never thought of our old dishwasher as loud until we ran the LG. You can barely hear it running even when standing right next to it. We don't use the 3rd upper rack - it simply does not appeal to us. And we use the silverware holders from our old dishwasher because we didn't like the one long holder that was meant to be placed at the back of the dishwasher. There is ample room without that for a week's worth of our dishes since there are only 2 of us at home. Generally, everything comes clean but one plastic container with chopped cilantro in it did not and I had to hand wash it to get the cilantro leaf pieces off the side of the container. I am also concerned that the inside of the door stays wet even days after the dishwasher has been run and I am concerned what the long term effect of that will be. Nevertheless, we are generally very pleased with our new LG dishwasher and I recommend it.

Sentence (English): We purchased this model because it was recommended as Consumer Reports' best budget option and was given honorable mention in a This Old House post.
Comments (English): We purchased this model because it was recommended as Consumer Reports' best budget option and was given honorable mention in a This Old House post. Overall, it is fine and meets our need as a couple with no children. The inside is much smaller than our last model, though thankfully we thought to swap out the bottom rack and silverware holder with our old model and the spacing of the spokes gives you room for more dishes than the original rack. I should've paid more attention to the capacity, because we definitely lost room and I have to hand wash a pan or two each night. For drying purposes, we use the high heat/auto dry settings. When the load is finished we open the door, set a thin hand towel over it, and lightly close the door so that the material can absorb moisture. This trick worked perfectly with our last model, but with this one there is still a LOT of water after a cycle and the towel trick. It's very difficult to place any dishes on an angle, so there is lots of standing water on mugs, instant pot insert, etc. The actual cleaning is perfect, we've had no troubles. We needed a more affordable option to get us through a few years while we save up for a new set of appliances and for the price we will have just that. Even with adding on the warranty, we waited for a labor day 20% off and couldn't pass up the low price. A good deal for the product, but you're not getting the best quality available among even the more budget friendly options.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher was bought on 08-23-2023.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher was bought on 08-23-2023. I bought it because I wanted a Bosch, and this model would fit my old plumbing. After my purchase I went home and read the reviews. Very upset because some reviewers said you need a smart phone to work your dishwasher. Those Comments proved mostly FALSE. Yes, you need a smart phone for some features, but you can use your dishwasher without a smart phone. Also, I want to make note of the fact that the names of the buttons (in the manual) do not correspond to the names of the buttons on the dishwasher. To Operate: First press the button all the way to the left of the dishwasher. That button says "Reset 4 Sec.". Next press the button that says "Normal" (if that's the cycle you want). I always use the normal cycle. The next button I press says "Extra Dry" (had to press the extra dry button a few times for it to go on). Lastly press "Start/Resume" it is the button all the way to the right. And, that's it, Folks. Now, the next time you use your dishwasher, press the button all the way to the left which is "Reset 4 Sec.". The "Normal" and "Extra Dry" buttons will come on automatically. And, then press the "Start/Resume" button. So, after the first time you use your dishwasher, you will only have to press those two buttons ("Reset 4 Sec." and "Start/Resume") to start your dishwasher (unless you want to change a setting.I use a lot of cat bowls, and use a lot of plastic. Everything dries beautifully. One more thing, when the dishwasher is done it makes a little noise. Wait until the second noise to empty the dishwasher because the stainless-steel tub is still pulling water away from the dishes after the first noise. You will need a smart phone to change the volume of the little noise your dishwasher makes.I hope I was helpful. I wish I would have had these instuctions when I purchased my dishwasher. Hopefully I can help someone else.

Sentence (English): Short version: I give this dishwasher a 4.5/5 stars and definitely recommend it, but I give using Costco a 0.5/5 stars.
Comments (English): [ Buy Your Bosch Elsewhere ] || ---------------- || Short version: I give this dishwasher a 4.5/5 stars and definitely recommend it, but I give using Costco a 0.5/5 stars. Buy this dishwasher (or another Bosch), just not through Costco. Long version: I had a 'working' GE dishwasher at home, but it wouldn't clean the dishes unless they were already pre hand-washed. As my household runs the dishwasher 7-8 times per week, it was using up to 6+ hours of my week prewashing and doing the dishes. My sole objective was therefore to find a dishwasher that would actually clean the dishes for me so I could better use my time. This Bosch cleans the dishes about 98% of perfect with minimal handling on my part (just scraping or a quick rinse to get large pieces of food off, with the exception of having to pre-clean deep water bottles, wooden spatulas, silverware, and the blender parts). However, it only cleans this well on the 'Auto' setting, which does take a whopping 2 hours and 20 minutes (the 'Normal' setting is 2 hours and 15 minuts). On the 'Speed60' setting, it takes 1 hour and 10 minutes, and only gets them about 92% clean. The tines are also a bit awkward to optimally arrange the dishes. Even with these limitations, it has largely satisfied my goal of saving time every day! And for that, I definitely recommend it! I also surprisingly love the third rack (and prior to purchasing was ambivalent about needing an additional rack). It is also very quiet, although not my reason for buying it. I also love that it has a towel bar. Now, on to Costco being a huge disappointment. To preface, I am a Costco SuperFan. My friends and neighbors must assume I am a paid Costco sponsor because I am always singing its praises. Not this time, sadly. I ordered several appliances at the same time, thinking it would be cheaper and would consolidate installation. Wrong on both accounts. My other appliance installation, a washing machine, was scheduled for the same day, but was canceled. Costco did not notify me it was canceled (I still received the automatic reminder call with my install time window the day before, but it did not specify which appliance it was for, and I assumed it was for both). Wrong. I spent all day waiting for the washer to be installed. I finally had to contact Costco about it, and only then did they prompt me to choose a new install date. It should also be mentioned that it took FOREVER to reach a human to speak with each time I needed to call Costco (one time I left my callback number, but never got a call back). I also used the online chat function, which also took FOREVER. When the dishwasher showed up and the installers (FYI Costco uses third-party contractors; I am located in Northern California), they informed me that the power cord would not reach the outlet (despite the dishwasher being immediately to the left of the sink). (The water line was apparently not long enough either, but the installers ran to a hardware store and got a longer one.) In an attempt to get the power cord to reach, they hand drilled a hole in my internal cabinetry drywall. When they were leaving (after having somehow been there over two hours with not much to show for it), they informed me that the cord still would not reach and I would have to buy an extension cord/power strip. An exposed power cord! Under a sink where water may be present! What? And even worse was that they expected me, the customer, to take care of this. If you call a plumber to fix a leaking toilet, would you expect them to ask you to provide the toilet ring or other necessary supplies? NO! If you called a contractor to build a fence, would you be expected to provide the materials? NO! So why was I expected to deal with this, something I know absolutely nothing about? I informed the installers that an extension cord was not going to be an acceptable solution. They contacted their boss, who stated they would in fact take care of it. Well, they did not. They never even followed up with me. I then left a voicemail for the boss, who never even returned my call. I then contacted Costco, because they have a reputation for such great customer service, right, and ensuring the customer is taken care of? Not this time! They transferred me to the Resolutions Team at Costco, who eventually responded to my repeated inquiries, and informed me that Costco would not be able to do anything and I would have to take care of it! Keep in mind, I either had to use an extension cord to get my dishwasher to work, or else did not have a functional dishwasher this entire time. I then had to research getting a longer power cord. I called Bosch, who sent me the longest cord they had. My spouse and I then had to figure out how to move/uninstall the dishwasher to reach the power cord. Guess what? It was the SAME EXACT LENGTH as the cord that was already installed. What? You don't think the installers or Bosch could have inquired/notified me of this before the circus began trying to get a longer cord? (Perhaps Costco should include this disclaimer or enter a manual measurement/instructions to measure the necessary length of cords also.) So, what did my spouse and I do at this point? We did what the original installers should have done all along: we drilled a hole in the appropriate place (at the BOTTOM, where the cords go, not the top and kitty corner - you know, the shortest line from A to B to reach the outlet). It was a very difficult process for us, as the metal clip that goes around the water drain line fell off in the abyss between the dishwasher and the cabinetry drywall, and took extensive cuts on my arm, awkward positioning, tongs, and 20 minutes of trying to successfully retrieve it. The point being, WHY DID WE THE CUSTOMER HAVE TO DO THIS? The installers should have been able to figure it out if we could! So much time and energy was wasted in this whole process. It took almost three months for completion. In summary, I have never been so disappointed in Costco. The entire process was fraught, and most importantly, Costco did not stand by the customer. Be sure to take your appliance business elsewhere.

Sentence (English): Bought this dishwasher 8/25/23.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Bought this dishwasher 8/25/23. Some reviews said you couldn't use this without a smart phone; however, that information is mostly false. The odd thing is the names of buttons in the manual do not correspond to the names of the buttons on the dishwasher. To operate without a smart phone do the following: First press the button all the way over on the left. On the dishwasher, this button says, "Reset 4 Sec.". Next select which cycle you want. I always us "Normal" (so press 'normal'). Next press the "Extra Dry" button (had to hit this button a few times to make it stay on). Lastly, press the button all the way over to the right which is "Start/Resume". The next time you use your dishwasher, Press the button all way over to the left. That button is "Reset 4 Sec.". After you press the "Reset 4 Sec." button, the buttons you used the last time you used your dishwasher ("Normal" and "Extra Dry") will go on automatically. Now press the button all the way over the right which is "Start/Resume". So, unless you want to change settings, after the first wash (unless you want to change settings), you will only press two buttons which are: "Reset 4 Sec." and "Start/Resume" . I have cats, and have a lot of plastic, and this dishwasher does gets all the bowls dry. Please remember to use 'Jet Dry' because it helps get your dishes dryer. Now, one more thing. When your dishwasher is done it will make a cute little noise. Keep the dishes in the dishwasher until you hear the second noise. The reason for this is that the stain-less steel tub will still be pulling water away from your dishes between the two noises. To change the volume of the noise, you will (more than likely) need a smart phone. I hope I have helped someone. I felt this was necessary to write since it took me a while to figure out how to use my dishwasher without a smart phone. Our wonderful installer tried to help, but this is a brand new model of dishwasher, so I had to muddle through it myself. You should really be pleased with this dishwasher. The run time is long, but the dishwasher is very quiet. However, it is NOT so quiet that you can't hear it run. For me, that is a plus. I like to know the dishwasher is working. Thank you for reading this.

Sentence (English): I often encountered Media Brand when I was working overseas, so it was nice to see it in Korea.
Comments (English): [ Clean design, media-worthy dishwasher, very satisfying! ] || ---------------- || I often encountered Media Brand when I was working overseas, so it was nice to see it in Korea. I knew it was primarily an OEM and ODM company, and I often used Media's own brand products. Perhaps because of that experience, I didn't feel any resistance to the brand. I purchased this dishwasher to install for my mother at my parents' house. Washing dishes is a time-consuming chore, and my mother is elderly, so standing for long periods of time is difficult. Since my parents' house doesn't typically have a lot of dishes, I purchased a 6-seater instead of a 12-seater. This is a truly great value product. The installer contacted me right away through Coupang Rocket. (This reminds me of how great Coupang Rocket is.) The reasonable price and very satisfying features make this Media 6-person dishwasher highly recommended! ^^!
Comments (Original): [ 깔끔한 디자인, 미디어 갓성비 식세기 대만족! ] || ---------------- || 미디어 브랜드는 해외에 주재원으로 있을때자주 접했던 브랜드인데 국내에서 보니 반갑네요.OEM, ODM 위주의 업체로 알고있고미디어 자체 브랜드 제품도 자주 사용했었습니다.그래서 그런지 사용경험이 있어, 브랜드는 거부감이 없었습니다.본가 어머니께 설치해 드리려고 구매했습니다.설거지가 집안일에서 시간도 오래 걸리고어머니께서 연로하신만큼 장시간 서서하기도 힘든 일이구요.본가는 일반적으로 설거지 양이 많지 않아서12인용이 아닌 6인용을 구매했습니다.12인용은 사이즈가 커서 공간을 확보하고 설치해야 하는데6인용은 컴팩트한 사이즈라 공간차지가 적고설치하는데 큰 어려움이 없어서 좋았습니다.구매하고 바로 기사님께서 연락주셔서일정을 잡았구요, 설치도 간단하게 끝났습니다.제가 느낀 가장 큰 장점은1. 대용량사진이나 외관상으로 6인용이 그렇게 커보이지 않았는데막상 사용해보니 후라이팬, 텀블러, 접시 계속들어가네요...트레이가 분리가 없고 크고 넓어서 수납력이 뛰어납니다.2. 간편함시간절약이 너무 좋습니다, 미쳤어요!세제넣고 버튼 몇개만 누르고 쉬러가면 됩니다.(세제는 식세기 전용 세제가 따로 있습니다)세척코스가 다양하여 필요에 따라 선택하면 간편합니다.진작 구매할껄이란 생각이 드네요.3. 가성비 미디어가 가성비 좋은 브랜드인건 알고 있었는데국내 대기업 가격대랑 비교하면 거의 반값이네요…로켓으로 빠르게 온다는 점과 기사님이 무료로 진행하는방문설치까지 고려하면 이게 맞나(?) 싶은 정도입니다.너무 저렴해서 제품 받고나서 프레임 마감상태, 실구동 성능들을 최대한 유심히 관찰하였는데마감상태고 매우 깔끔하고 기능역시 문제없이 작동합니다.갓 오브 갓성비 제품입니다.쿠팡로켓으로 설치도 기사님께서 바로 연락주시고(쿠팡로켓이 정말 대단하다고 새삼스레 느껴지는...)거품없는 가격, 기능도 매우 만족스러운미디어 6인용 식기세척기 강력추천 합니다. ^^!

Anyway, it is a product I really love.
